newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel prices steepen tracking NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel prices steepen tracking NYMEX rally.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials hovered near steady Monday, though outright prices rallied sharply tracking the gains on the NYMEX.
September heating oil futures on the NYMEX gained 1.88 cents to settle the session at 58.44 cents a gallon.
U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands several times at 0.40 cents over the September futures, nearly even with Friday levels, traders said.
Prompt low-sulphur 55-grade jet fuel traded at 0.65 cent over the September NYMEX Monday, keeping its premium to the 54-grade steady.
Traders discounted talk that the strike by UPS workers would cause a glut in jet fuel, since the company's offtake is probably not significant enough to dampen prices.
"And they're too spread out to make a difference in any one area," one trader said."
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
